title: Unique Crunchy Middle Eastern Onion Ouzi
description: A salty, crunchy, nostalgic Middle Eastern dish featuring onion, served in a salt block vessel, this ouzi is anti-inflammatory friendly and full of flavor. It combines the crunch of fried onions with the comfort of khao khuas rice.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onions and cook until they are golden brown and crispy.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked khao khuas rice, toasted fry grind rice, turmeric, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked onions to the bowl and stir until everything is well combined.
Spoon the mixture into a salt block vessel.
Serve the ouzi hot, garnished with additional paprika if desired.
Let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator.
Reheat the ouzi in the oven or microwave until it is crispy and hot.
